title: Materials Project
description: Documented public materials database (LBNL / DOE) for the Material Genome Database Builder capability area.
body:
Materials Project is a documented materials database from LBNL / DOE. 150,000+ computed inorganic compounds with structures, band gaps, and phase diagrams — the reference open materials genome.

How it works: It works by tokenizing the query and scoring each knowledge-base row on term overlap, returning the match count and top hits.

Documented uses of this capability area include alloy design for aerospace, metamaterial antennas and cloaks, composite airframes, and failure-life prediction for critical structures.
